Name: 7 Gunfighters
Overview: 7 Gunfighters is a Wild West first-person shooter in which the player takes on the role of a bounty hunter who is going after a band of seven outlaws who all think they are the best shot's in the Old West. A bounty has been placed on all of their heads. There are seven levels in total, one for each outlaw. The player starts each level by choosing and outlaw, and then fights his way through the henchmen in order to apprehend the boss and collect the reward. Levels are small and simple in design. The player can move around freely and shoot the bandits that pop up from behind objects and structures. The weapon needs to be reloaded regularly and the difficulty level can be adjusted. There are no pick-ups and there is but a single weapon.
